examples.en: The noise which caused the disturbance has stopped.
examples.zh: 造成干擾的噪音已經停止了。

DEPARTURE.example: Our time of departure is 8 AM.

examples.en: The departure was delayed due to heavy rain.
examples.zh: 由於大雨，出發時間延遲了。

examples.en: Please check the departure board for your flight.
examples.zh: 請查看航班出發時刻表。

WHO.example: A: who is sitting next to Tom today? B: It is our new classmate, Jason.
WHO.exampleZh: 根據回答「新同學 Jason」，可知在詢問坐在旁邊的「人是誰」，疑問詞選 Who。

THAT.example: It was the lack of consultation that angered local residents.
THAT.exampleZh: It was X that... 是強調句。

WHICH.example: The report, which was due today, is delayed.
WHICH.exampleZh: 逗號後的補充說明（非限定子句）只能用 which，不能用 that。

WAS DISCUSSING.example: The marketing team was discussing the new strategy when the CEO walked into the room.
WAS DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 由 when 帶出的過去簡單式（walked）可知，主要子句應使用過去進行式，表示當時正在進行的動作

MOVING.example: Our manager suggested moving the weekly meeting to Thursday morning.
MOVING.exampleZh: suggest（建議）後面必須接動名詞（V-ing）作受詞，不能接不定詞。

WAS WRITING.example: I was writing an email to my colleague when my computer suddenly shut down.
WAS WRITING.exampleZh: 描述過去某個時間點正在發生的事（寫信），被另一個突發動作（關機）打斷，使用過去進行式

TO ANSWER.meaning: 停下原本的動作，轉而去做另一件事
TO ANSWER.example: A: Did you manage to finish the report? B: No, I stopped to answer a phone call, and then it was time to leave.
TO ANSWER.exampleZh: stop to V 表示「停下原本的動作，轉而去做另一件事」。

WERE HIKING.example: While they were hiking through the dense forest, they discovered a rare species of bird.
WERE HIKING.exampleZh: While 引導的子句通常使用進行式，表示在過去一段持續的時間內（徒步旅行中）發生了另一件事（發現鳥類）

TO WORK.example: Many employees plan to work from home at least twice a week.
TO WORK.exampleZh: plan（計畫）後面必須接不定詞（to V）當作受詞。

WERE TESTING.example: At 8 PM last night, the technicians were testing the new artificial intelligence system.
WERE TESTING.exampleZh: 句子明確點出過去的特定時間（At 8 PM last night），此時應使用過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作

TO LOCK.example: I completely forgot to lock the office door when I left yesterday evening.
TO LOCK.exampleZh: forget to V 表示「忘記去做某事（事情還沒做）」。

WERE YOU DOING.example: A: What were you doing when the earthquake hit? B: I was reading a book in the living room.
WERE YOU DOING.exampleZh: 根據回答「I was reading...」以及 when 帶出的過去時間，問句需用過去進行式

HEARING.example: I look forward to hearing from you.
HEARING.exampleZh: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。

WERE DISCUSSING.example: They were discussing the budget for next year when the power went out.
WERE DISCUSSING.exampleZh: 描述過去正在進行的動作（討論預算）被突發事件（停電 went out）打斷

WHOSE.example: A: whose bag is this on the classroom chair? B: It belongs to our teacher, Mr. Chen.
WHOSE.exampleZh: 詢問物品「是誰的」所有權，疑問詞使用 Whose。

WAS PREPARING.meaning: 過去同時正在發生的兩個動作
WAS PREPARING.example: While the chef was preparing the ingredients, the waiters were setting up the tables.
WAS PREPARING.exampleZh: While 引導的子句常用進行式，且後方子句為 were setting up，表示過去同時正在發生的兩個動作

WAS GIVING.example: The CEO was giving a speech about sustainable development when the microphone stopped working.
WAS GIVING.exampleZh: 過去某個持續進行的動作（正在演講）被另一個過去動作（麥克風壞掉）打斷，用過去進行式

TO REDUCE PLASTIC WASTE.example: 【短文】Environmental News: The government plans to implement a new policy that requires all supermarkets to charge for plastic bags. This aims to reduce plastic waste. Q: What is the purpose of the new policy?
TO REDUCE PLASTIC WASTE.exampleZh: 文中最後一句明確指出「This aims to reduce plastic waste」，也就是減少塑膠垃圾

WATCHING.example: I remember watching this movie before; the ending is very surprising.
WATCHING.exampleZh: remember V-ing 表示「記得曾經做過某事」。

WERE WAITING.example: They were waiting for the bus when it started to rain heavily.
WERE WAITING.exampleZh: 描述在過去某個時間點正在進行的動作（等公車），被下雨這件事打斷

COLLEAGUE.example: My colleague helped me with the report.
COLLEAGUE.exampleZh: 我的同事幫我完成報告。

DISCUSS.exampleZh: 我們明天討論這個計畫。

examples.zh: 這條新捷運線運送的旅客人數比舊快捷線更多。

INVOLVE.exampleZh: 幾個部門都參與了這個新專案。

examples.zh: 幾個部門都參與了這個新專案。

examples.zh: 這份工作包含頻繁地到不同國家出差。

examples.zh: 她答應要幫我寫作業。

examples.en: He kept his promise and arrived on time.
examples.zh: 他信守承諾，準時到達了。

examples.zh: 如果你努力學習，你將會實現你的夢想。

examples.zh: 打電話給診所預約掛號。

examples.en: She was late for her doctor appointment.
examples.zh: 她看醫生的預約遲到了。

ORGANIZE.example: The meeting has been organized for tomorrow.
ORGANIZE.exampleZh: 會議已經安排在明天舉行。

examples.en: If you organize your files, you will find them easily.
examples.zh: 如果你把檔案整理好，你會很容易找到它們。

examples.zh: 員工被鼓勵分享他們的創意想法。

examples.zh: 我的老闆一直鼓勵我學習更多技能。

ARRANGE.example: I'll arrange a meeting for Monday.

RECOMMEND.example: I will recommend this book to my friends.

examples.zh: 你能推薦我一家好的飯店嗎？

RESERVATION.meaning: 預先訂妥座位或房間的安排
RESERVATION.example: Our reservation is for six thirty.

examples.en: Our reservation is for six thirty.
examples.zh: 我們預訂六點半。

examples.en: Please give the name on the reservation.
examples.zh: 請告知訂位姓名。

WERE ANALYZING.example: The scientists were analyzing the effects of the new diet when the fire alarm rang.
WERE ANALYZING.exampleZh: 這是一個測試「過去進行式」的句子，表示在過去某個特定時間點（火災警報響起時）正在進行的動作，因此選擇 B. were analyzing

WERE MEASURING.meaning: 過去某段時間正在進行的事
WERE MEASURING.example: A: What were the researchers doing in the lab yesterday morning? B: They were measuring the participants' blood pressure and heart rates.
WERE MEASURING.exampleZh: 問句使用的是過去進行式 (were doing)，表示過去某段時間正在進行的事，故回答也應保持一致，使用 A. were measuring

TO LAUNCH.example: The local clinic plans to launch a free wellness program for seniors next month.
TO LAUNCH.exampleZh: 動詞 plan 後面必須接不定詞 (to + V)，表示計畫要做的事，因此正確答案為 B. to launch。

WAS UPDATING.example: The nurse was updating the patient's medical records when the hospital's computer system crashed.
WAS UPDATING.exampleZh: 句意表示當電腦系統當機的那一刻，護士「正在」更新病歷

TO CONSTRUCT.example: The mayor agreed to construct more bike lanes in the downtown area to reduce traffic jams.
TO CONSTRUCT.exampleZh: 動詞 agree 後面必須接不定詞 (to + V) 表示同意去做某事，因此選擇 D. to construct。

WAS WAITING.example: I was waiting for the express train when I heard the station announcement.
WAS WAITING.exampleZh: 表示在過去聽到廣播的瞬間，我「正在」等車，需使用過去進行式 B. was waiting

WERE FIXING.example: A: Why was the road blocked yesterday? B: Because the workers were fixing the broken traffic lights.
WERE FIXING.exampleZh: 問句描述昨天的情況，回答說明當時正在進行的動作（修復紅綠燈），因此需要用過去進行式 C. were fixing

TO TAKE.example: To save money and protect the environment, we decided to take public transport instead of driving.
TO TAKE.exampleZh: 動詞 decide 後面固定接不定詞 (to + V) 表示決定去做某事，因此選 D. to take。

WAS DRAFTING.meaning: 當電源突然中斷時，我『正在
WAS DRAFTING.example: I was drafting an important email to a client when the power suddenly went out.
WAS DRAFTING.exampleZh: 「當電源突然中斷時，我『正在』起草電子郵件」，一個過去動作打斷了另一個過去正在進行的動作，需用過去進行式，選 B

TO RAISE.example: During the meeting, she hesitated to raise the controversial issue because the boss was in a bad mood.
TO RAISE.exampleZh: 動詞 hesitate（猶豫）後面接不定詞 (to + V)，表示對做某事感到遲疑，因此正確答案為 D. to raise。

WERE DEBATING.meaning: 主要子句描述當時也正在進行的另一個動作
WERE DEBATING.example: A: Did they agree on the new marketing strategy? B: I'm not sure. They were debating it while they were having lunch.
WERE DEBATING.exampleZh: while 引導的子句使用過去進行式 (were having)，主要子句描述當時也正在進行的另一個動作，時態需一致，因此選 C. were debating

PAYING.example: Active listening requires paying close attention to the speaker's body language.

WERE PRACTICING.example: The traditional dancers were practicing their routine when it suddenly started to pour rain.

TO SEE.example: Tourists from all over the world travel to Taiwan to see the famous sky lanterns.

WERE PERFORMING.example: A: How was the concert at the cultural center? B: Amazing! While the musicians were performing , the crowd cheered loudly.
WERE PERFORMING.exampleZh: while 連接過去某段時間內正在進行的動作，且對話談論的是過去的一場演唱會，故需使用過去進行式 A. were performing

TO LEARN.example: Were he to learn the truth, he would be furious.
TO LEARN.exampleZh: Were + 主詞 + to V：與未來相反的假設（= If he were to learn）。

WAS READING.example: I was reading the instruction manual when the device suddenly shut off by itself.
WAS READING.exampleZh: 當設備突然自己關機時，我「正在」閱讀說明書

TO ISSUE.example: The online store refused to issue a full refund for the laptop, stating that the warranty had expired.
TO ISSUE.exampleZh: 動詞 refuse（拒絕）後面必須接不定詞 (to + V)，表示拒絕做某事，因此正確答案為 C. to issue。

WAS HELPING.example: A: Did you resolve the billing issue? B: No, the customer service representative was helping me when the line suddenly disconnected.

CHECKING.example: Please keep checking the online tracking number until the package safely arrives at your door.
CHECKING.exampleZh: 動詞 keep 表示「持續做某事」時，後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此選 B. checking。

TO SIGN.example: The gym requires all members to sign a health form before using the swimming pool.
TO SIGN.exampleZh: require somebody to do something（要求某人做某事）是固定用法，需接不定詞，故選 D. to sign。

TO COMPLETE.example: They aim to complete the construction of the new laboratory by next spring.
TO COMPLETE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 aim (目標在於) 後方需接不定詞 (to V)，表示未來的企圖或目標。

WAS.example: The new software was installed on all office computers yesterday afternoon.

USING.example:

WAS INTERVIEWING.example: The journalist was interviewing the celebrity when the celebrity suddenly got angry.
WAS INTERVIEWING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：突然生氣 (got angry) 為過去式突發事件，前面正在進行的採訪動作需用過去進行式

TO SECURE.example: Many startup founders struggle to secure funding during their first year of business.

WERE TRAINING.example: The athletes were training in the gym when the fire alarm sounded.

ESTIMATING.example: You should try estimating portion sizes visually instead of weighing everything.

WAS EXPLAINING.example: The HR director was explaining the benefits package when the projector turned off.
WAS EXPLAINING.exampleZh: 配合 when 引導的過去突發事件（turned off），主要子句應使用過去進行式表示當時正在說明的動作

TO RENT.example:

WAS DOING.example:

A TRADITIONAL DANCE PERFORMANCE.meaning: 說明野狗出現前他們正在看傳統舞蹈表演

WAS FLASHING.example: The battery indicator was flashing red when the laptop completely shut down.

EXPOSING.example: exposing the tablet to extreme heat will cause serious damage.

WERE CLOSING.example:

TO NEED.example:

TO NEED.exampleZh: 連綴動詞 seem 後方若接動詞，必須使用不定詞（to + V）。

FORMAT THE MEMORY CARD.meaning: 拍照前必須先將其格式化

WERE PLANTING.example: The volunteers were planting trees in the park when it started raining heavily.
WERE PLANTING.exampleZh: 【時態】when 引導的子句表示過去某個發生的時間點，主要子句應使用過去進行式表示「當時正在進行的動作」

TO RIDE.example: Instead of driving to work, she chose to ride a bicycle to reduce carbon emissions.
TO RIDE.exampleZh: 【文法】動詞 choose（過去式為 chose）後方需接不定詞（to V）表示「選擇去做某事」。

WAS ATTENDING.example: I was attending a virtual meeting when my internet connection unexpectedly dropped.
WAS ATTENDING.exampleZh: 【時態】when my internet connection dropped 是過去發生的單一事件，當時「我」正在進行某個動作，應使用過去進行式

TO CHOOSE.example: The company allows employees to choose flexible hours as long as they complete their tasks.
TO CHOOSE.exampleZh: 【文法】allow 的用法是 allow someone to do something（允許某人做某事），後方必須接不定詞 (to V)。

FAST INTERNET CONNECTIONS.example:
【短文】Business Article: Co-working spaces, which offer high-speed internet and quiet areas, are becoming extremely popular among freelancers.
Q: What is an advantage of co-working spaces mentioned in the article?
FAST INTERNET CONNECTIONS.exampleZh: 【閱讀】短文中提到 shared spaces 提供 high-speed internet (高速網路) 以及安靜的區域，這對應到 B 選項的 Fast internet connections

TO WIN.example: The young gymnast hopes to win a gold medal at the upcoming international championship.
TO WIN.exampleZh: 【文法】hope（希望）後方應接不定詞 (to V)，表示對未來的期盼。

WAS SLEEPING.example:
A: Did you catch the baseball game last night?

WAS SLEEPING.exampleZh: 【時態】當全壘打被擊出時（過去的一瞬間），說話者「當時正在」睡覺

WAS CHECKING.example:
A: How was your experience at the diner?

WAS CHECKING.exampleZh: 【時態】while I was trying to order (當我正試著點餐時) 使用了過去進行式，表示同一時段服務生也「正在」看手機，故前後應一致使用過去進行式

IT RECENTLY STARTED OPERATING.exampleZh: 【閱讀】短文提到 which opened just last week (上週才剛開幕)，對應 D 選項「它最近才開始營運」

SPEAKING.example: Many adults practice speaking foreign languages by conversing with native speakers online.
SPEAKING.exampleZh: 【文法】practice (練習) 後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing)。

PUTTING ITEMS INTO BOXES.meaning: 當消息宣布時作者正在做什麼？
PUTTING ITEMS INTO BOXES.example:
Volunteer Diary: I was packing donation boxes when the coordinator told us we had broken the record for this year's fundraiser. Everyone cheered.
Q: What was the writer doing when the news was announced?
PUTTING ITEMS INTO BOXES.exampleZh: 本題測驗閱讀理解與過去進行式。

TO FIX THE ELEVATOR.meaning: 房東答應修復壞掉的電梯
TO FIX THE ELEVATOR.example:
Property Update: The landlord promised to repair the broken elevator next week. Residents who live on higher floors have complained about climbing the stairs daily.
Q: What did the landlord promise?

MEDITATION.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「本題測驗閱讀理解」。

WATCH THEIR BAGS.example: 【短文】Travel Alert: Passengers who are waiting for Flight 102 should keep an eye on their luggage. Pickpockets are active in the terminal. Q: What is the advice for passengers?
WATCH THEIR BAGS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文提到「should keep an eye on their luggage」（應該留意自己的行李），選項 (A) Watch their bags 符合此建議

WERE OBSERVING.example: They were observing the chemical reaction when the glass tube broke.
WERE OBSERVING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：本題測試過去進行式

DURING THE FORMULA TEST.example: 【短文】Lab Report: While the team was testing the new formula, they noticed an unusual color change. This discovery might lead to a breakthrough in medicine. Q: When did the team notice the color change?
DURING THE FORMULA TEST.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到「While the team was testing the new formula, they noticed...」（當團隊正在測試新配方時，他們注意到...），因此是在測試期間發生的，選 (B)

WAS CHOPPING.example: The chef was chopping the vegetables when the pot boiled over.
WAS CHOPPING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：當鍋子沸騰溢出 (boiled over) 時，廚師「正在切」蔬菜，強調過去某時間點正在進行的動作，因此用過去進行式 was chopping，選 (D)

TO ADD.example:
A: Do you like the curry?
B: Yes, but the chef warned me not to add too much chili sauce.
TO ADD.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：warn sb. (not) to V 表示「警告某人（不要）做某事」，必須使用不定詞。

TOUCHING THE FOOD.meaning: 觸碰食物能提升用餐體驗
TOUCHING THE FOOD.example: 【短文】Culture Blog: In some cultures, people enjoy eating with their hands. It is believed that touching the food enhances the dining experience. Q: What is believed to enhance the dining experience?
TOUCHING THE FOOD.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文明確指出「touching the food enhances the dining experience」（觸碰食物能提升用餐體驗），因此答案為 (C)

TO WEAR.example: The new policy requires all staff to wear a security badge at all times.
TO WEAR.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 require（要求）的用法為 require sb. to V，表示「要求某人做某事」。

WAS DELIVERING.example: The director was delivering a speech when the microphone stopped working.
WAS DELIVERING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：麥克風故障是過去瞬間發生的事，當時主管「正在發表」演講，須用過去進行式，正確答案為 (A) was delivering

TO PAUSE.example: She decided to pause her acting career to spend more time with her family.
TO PAUSE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 decide（決定）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)，表示決定去做某事，因此答案為 (C)。

UNCONFIDENT.example: 【短文】Magazine Article: 「I was struggling with self-doubt when I got my first major role,」 the actress shared. 「That moment changed my life completely.」 Q: How did the actress feel before her first major role?
UNCONFIDENT.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文章提到女演員當時「struggling with self-doubt」（深受自我懷疑所苦），這表示她缺乏自信 (Unconfident)，故選 (A)

TO WASH.example: It is essential to wash your hands frequently while traveling abroad.
TO WASH.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：句型 It is + 形容詞 + to V 中，It 為虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的不定詞片語 (to wash...)，因此選 (B)。

BEING.example: I would appreciate being informed before any announcement is made.
BEING.exampleZh: appreciate 後動名詞，being informed 為被告知。

IN THEIR FRONT POCKETS.meaning: 把錢包放在前面的口袋
IN THEIR FRONT POCKETS.example: 【短文】Safety Guide: Tourists should practice keeping their wallets in front pockets. Pickpockets often target people who leave valuables in their bags. Q: Where should tourists keep their wallets?
IN THEIR FRONT POCKETS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文明確建議「keeping their wallets in front pockets」（把錢包放在前面的口袋），因此選 (B)

WAS ANALYZING.example: I was analyzing the data when the computer system crashed.
WAS ANALYZING.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：電腦當機是過去瞬間動作，當時我「正在分析」數據，須使用過去進行式，選 (D)

TO THINK.example: The professor encouraged the students to think outside the box.
TO THINK.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 encourage 的用法為 encourage sb. to V（鼓勵某人做某事），故選 (A) to think。

TO ALLOW.example:
A: Did you read the company memo?
B: Yes, they plan to allow remote work permanently.
TO ALLOW.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：動詞 plan（計畫）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)，表示計畫去做某事，因此正確答案為 (D) to allow。

WAS STRUGGLING.exampleZh: 後半句為過去簡單式（organized），While 帶出的背景動作通常為過去進行式，表示當時政府正為了找尋解方而努力

TO FIRE.example: The manager threatened to fire the employee if he continued to be late for work.
TO FIRE.exampleZh: threaten（威脅）後面須接不定詞（to V），表示威脅要去做某事。

HABITAT LOSS.example: 【短文】Wildlife Conservation: The organization focuses on protecting sea turtles, which are currently facing extinction due to habitat loss. Volunteers patrol the beaches every night. Q: What is causing the sea turtles to face extinction?
HABITAT LOSS.exampleZh: 文中提到「facing extinction due to habitat loss」，due to 表示原因，即棲息地喪失

COMMUNICATE.example: They have communicated the new policy to the team.
COMMUNICATE.exampleZh: 他們已經向團隊傳達了新政策。

examples.en: They have communicated the new policy to the team.
examples.zh: 他們已經向團隊傳達了新政策。

examples.en: If we communicate clearly, there will be no errors.
examples.zh: 如果我們清楚地溝通，就不會有錯誤。

OPPORTUNITY.example: I have waited for this career opportunity for years.
OPPORTUNITY.exampleZh: 我已經等這個職業機會好幾年了。

examples.en: This great opportunity must not be missed.
examples.zh: 這個大好機會絕不能錯過。

examples.en: I have waited for this career opportunity for years.
examples.zh: 我已經等這個職業機會好幾年了。

ACCOMMODATION.example: Our accommodation has been booked for the trip.
ACCOMMODATION.exampleZh: 我們這趟旅行的住宿已經預訂好了。

examples.en: Our accommodation has been booked for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們這趟旅行的住宿已經預訂好了。

examples.en: If you travel during holidays, accommodation will be expensive.
examples.zh: 如果你在假日旅遊，住宿將會很昂貴。

examples.en: I must apologize to him.
examples.zh: 我必須向他道歉。

examples.en: She should apologize for being late.
examples.zh: 她應該為遲到而道歉。

DESTINATION.example: Tainan was our favorite travel destination last summer.
DESTINATION.exampleZh: 台南是我們去年夏天最喜歡的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The train is approaching its final destination at the moment.
examples.zh: 火車此刻正接近它的終點站目的地。

examples.en: Kyoto is the most popular destination among Taiwanese travelers.
examples.zh: 京都受台灣旅客歡迎的程度在所有目的地中名列前茅。

FREE ALLERGY TESTS.meaning: 診所本月提供免費過敏測試
FREE ALLERGY TESTS.example: 【短文】Clinic Notice: Patients who suffer from severe seasonal allergies should avoid outdoor activities during the spring. The clinic offers free allergy tests this month. Q: What does the clinic offer this month?
FREE ALLERGY TESTS.exampleZh: 告示中最後一句明確寫道「The clinic offers free allergy tests this month. (診所本月提供免費過敏測試)」，因此選 C

THE DEPARTMENT HEAD.example: 【短文】HR Memo: The specialist who usually handles conflict resolution is currently on leave. If you face any urgent issues, please contact the department head directly. Q: Who should employees contact for urgent issues?
THE DEPARTMENT HEAD.exampleZh: 備忘錄指出專家目前休假中，遇到緊急問題請直接聯絡「the department head (部門主管)」，因此選 B

IT SAVES COWORKERS TIME.meaning: 經常能節省同事的時間
IT SAVES COWORKERS TIME.example: 【短文】Email Etiquette: Professionals who write clear and concise emails often save their coworkers a lot of time. It is best to keep the subject line direct. Q: What is the benefit of writing clear emails?
IT SAVES COWORKERS TIME.exampleZh: 文中提到清楚簡潔的郵件「often save their coworkers a lot of time (經常能節省同事的時間)」，所以選 C

APPRECIATE.example: We appreciate the time you took to read our product description.
APPRECIATE.exampleZh: 我們感謝您撥冗閱讀我們的產品說明。

examples.en: We appreciate the time you took to read our product description.
examples.zh: 我們感謝您撥冗閱讀我們的產品說明。

examples.en: Your support is highly appreciated by our team.
examples.zh: 我們團隊非常感謝您的支持。

HIKING UP THE MOUNTAIN.meaning: 當我們正在爬山時，相機沒電了
HIKING UP THE MOUNTAIN.example:
【短文】Travel Blog: Yesterday, while we were hiking up the mountain, my camera battery died. I couldn't take any pictures of the sunset.
Q: What was the writer doing when the battery died?
HIKING UP THE MOUNTAIN.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文章明確提到「while we were hiking up the mountain, my camera battery died (當我們正在爬山時，相機沒電了)」，故選 A

TO FIND WEEKEND VOLUNTEERS.example:
【短文】Community Bulletin: The local library is recruiting volunteers to read stories to children on weekends. Anyone who enjoys working with kids is welcome.
Q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
TO FIND WEEKEND VOLUNTEERS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：第一句提到圖書館正在招募週末講故事給小孩聽的志工 (recruiting volunteers)，故 D 為此公告的目的

DID EVERYONE EVACUATE SAFELY.example: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
DID EVERYONE EVACUATE SAFELY.exampleZh: We were reviewing the shift schedule when the fire alarm went off.（當火災警報響起時，我們正在檢視班表

RETURNING WASHED ITEMS.meaning: 我們不接受退回已洗過或在戶外穿過的商品
RETURNING WASHED ITEMS.example:
【短文】Store Policy: Customers have 14 days to request a refund. However, we do not accept returning items that have been washed or worn outside.
Q: What action is not accepted for a refund?
RETURNING WASHED ITEMS.exampleZh: 政策中提到「we do not accept returning items that have been washed or worn outside」（我們不接受退回已洗過或在戶外穿過的商品）

CANCELING FREE SHIPPING.example:
【短文】Notice: We regret informing our members that free shipping is no longer available. You can choose to upgrade your membership to enjoy cheaper delivery fees.
Q: What change is the store making?
CANCELING FREE SHIPPING.exampleZh: 公告開頭表示「free shipping is no longer available」（不再提供免運費服務），意味著商店取消了免運費

TEENAGERS WHO LACK SLEEP.meaning: 亦即睡眠不足的青少年容易渴望不健康的零食
TEENAGERS WHO LACK SLEEP.example:
【短文】Health News: A recent study showed that teenagers who sleep less than seven hours a day tend to crave unhealthy snacks.
Q: Which group of people tends to crave unhealthy snacks?
TEENAGERS WHO LACK SLEEP.exampleZh: 研究指出「teenagers who sleep less than seven hours a day tend to crave unhealthy snacks」，亦即睡眠不足的青少年容易渴望不健康的零食

TO CREATE.example:
A: Why did you hire a health coach?
B: I failed to create a balanced meal plan on my own.
TO CREATE.exampleZh: 動詞 fail 後面必須接不定詞（to + V）表示「未能做到某事」。

SKIPPING LINES AT ATTRACTIONS.meaning: 可在多數主要景點免排隊
SKIPPING LINES AT ATTRACTIONS.example:
【短文】Tourism Brochure: Visitors who hold a special multi-day pass can skip the lines at most major attractions in the city.
Q: What is the benefit of the multi-day pass?
SKIPPING LINES AT ATTRACTIONS.exampleZh: 宣傳冊提到持有特別多日通行證的遊客「can skip the lines at most major attractions」（可在多數主要景點免排隊）

FINDING.example:
A: Are you enjoying the trip?
B: Yes, I can't imagine finding a better place for a summer vacation.
FINDING.exampleZh: 動詞 imagine（想像）後方接動詞時，必須使用動名詞（V-ing）作受詞。

UPDATING THE SOFTWARE.example:
【短文】Forum Post: I was updating my smart watch's software when the screen froze completely. Now it won't even turn on. Has anyone else experienced this?
Q: What was the user doing when the watch froze?
UPDATING THE SOFTWARE.exampleZh: 貼文提到「I was updating my smart watch's software when the screen froze completely」，說明手錶當機時，發文者正在更新軟體

TO LEAVE.example:
A: Should I leave it plugged in overnight?
B: No, the manufacturer warns users not to leave the charger plugged in overnight.
TO LEAVE.exampleZh: warn sb. not to do sth. 是固定用法，表示「警告某人不要做某事」，因此必須接不定詞（to leave）。

VEHICLE.example: You cannot park your vehicle here.
VEHICLE.exampleZh: 你不能把你的車輛停在這裡。

examples.en: You cannot park your vehicle here.
examples.zh: 你不能把你的車輛停在這裡。

examples.en: The police will check every vehicle on the road.
examples.zh: 警察將會檢查路上的每一輛車。

COMMUNITY.example: He has lived in this community for ten years.
COMMUNITY.exampleZh: 他已經在這個社區住了十年了。

examples.en: He has lived in this community for ten years.
examples.zh: 他已經在這個社區住了十年了。

examples.en: If you join our community, you will receive more support.
examples.zh: 如果你加入我們的社群，將會獲得更多支持。

CONVENIENT.example: The new subway line made our daily commute much faster last year.
CONVENIENT.exampleZh: 新地鐵線去年讓我們的日常通勤變快了許多。

examples.en: More people are using this convenient app to order food right now.
examples.zh: 現在越來越多人正在使用這款便利的應用程式來訂餐。

examples.en: Living near a convenience store is more convenient than living in the mountains.
examples.zh: 住在便利商店附近比住在山區方便多了。

BUYING LOCAL PRODUCE.example:
【短文】Green Living: We urge everyone to consider buying local produce. Doing this helps cut down on transportation emissions.

BUYING LOCAL PRODUCE.exampleZh: 【文法與閱讀】題目問作者建議人們考慮做什麼

TO ESTABLISH.example: The government aims to establish a nationwide network of electric vehicle charging stations within five years.
TO ESTABLISH.exampleZh: 【文法】動詞 aim 表示「目標在於、打算」時，後方接不定詞 (to V) 以構成 aim to do something。

SEPARATING.example: Many remote workers struggle with separating their professional and personal lives at home.
SEPARATING.exampleZh: 【文法】struggle with 的 with 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞必須改成動名詞 (V-ing) 型態。

THE SERVER UPGRADE PROCESS.example:
【短文】Office Memo: Yesterday afternoon, while the IT team was upgrading our servers, several employees experienced temporary login issues. The system is now fully restored.
Q: What caused the temporary login issues?
THE SERVER UPGRADE PROCESS.exampleZh: 【閱讀】短文指出，問題發生在「while the IT team was upgrading our servers (當 IT 團隊正在升級伺服器時)」，因此造成登入問題的原因是升級過程

STAYING.example: Remote employees should avoid staying entirely in their homes without taking breaks outside.
STAYING.exampleZh: 【文法】avoid (避免) 是一個後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 的動詞，表示避免做某事。

TO BOOK.example: If you want a table by the window, you had better attempt to book it in advance.
TO BOOK.exampleZh: 【文法】attempt (嘗試/試圖) 後方應接不定詞 (to V)。

ORDERING A SPECIFIC DESSERT.example:
【短文】Restaurant Review: We strongly suggest trying their chocolate lava cake. It is incredibly rich and melts in your mouth instantly.
Q: What does the reviewer suggest doing?
ORDERING A SPECIFIC DESSERT.exampleZh: 【閱讀】評論者強烈建議嘗試「chocolate lava cake (巧克力熔岩蛋糕)」，這是一道特定的甜點 (a specific dessert)

SOUVENIR.example: I bought a souvenir for my mom.
SOUVENIR.exampleZh: 我買了一個紀念品給媽媽。

ALTERNATIVE.example: We have no alternative but to close the store.
ALTERNATIVE.exampleZh: 除了關閉商店，我們別無選擇。

examples.en: We have no alternative but to close the store.
examples.zh: 除了關閉商店，我們別無選擇。

examples.en: Is there a cheaper alternative to this software?
examples.zh: 這個軟體有更便宜的替代方案嗎？

SENDING.example: The museum curator objected to sending the rare artifact to the overseas exhibition.
SENDING.exampleZh: 本題測驗片語中的動名詞。

TO ACQUIRE.meaning: 對某人來說做某事是...的
TO ACQUIRE.example: It is almost impossible for an average earner to acquire a property in this expensive district.
TO ACQUIRE.exampleZh: 本題測驗不定詞的特殊句型。

WERE DECORATING.example:
A: Is the charity gala still happening tonight? 
B: Yes, they were decorating the venue when the storm suddenly hit, but everything is fine now.

TO RECEIVE.example:
A: Why are they arguing? 
B: The residents demand to receive compensation from the construction company for the noise pollution.

SUPPLYING CLEAN WATER.example:
Charity Press Release: The non-profit organization, which focuses on providing clean water, is launching a new campaign in rural areas. They aim to build fifty wells by next year.
Q: What is the main focus of the organization?

ESTABLISHING THE NEW BUSINESS.example: 【短文】Executive Interview: 「When I was building the startup, I struggled with delegating tasks,」 the CEO confessed. 「Learning to trust my team was my biggest hurdle.」 Q: What was the CEO doing when he faced his biggest hurdle?
ESTABLISHING THE NEW BUSINESS.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：CEO 提到在「building the startup」（建立新創公司）時遇到了委派任務的困難，這與 (C) Establishing the new business（建立新事業）意義相同

SUFFERING PHYSICAL INJURIES.example: 【短文】Lab Precaution: Anyone who handles the acidic solutions must wear protective gloves. Failure to do so could result in severe chemical burns. Q: What is the consequence of not wearing gloves?
SUFFERING PHYSICAL INJURIES.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：短文提到不戴手套可能會導致「severe chemical burns」（嚴重的化學灼傷），屬於身體受傷，因此選項 (D) Suffering physical injuries 最符合

TO SUPPORT PSYCHOLOGICAL HEALTH.example: 【短文】Company Welfare: To promote mental well-being, the firm has introduced a flexible schedule. Employees who feel overwhelmed can now take mental health days without penalty. Q: What is the purpose of the new flexible schedule?
TO SUPPORT PSYCHOLOGICAL HEALTH.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：文章開頭即寫出「To promote mental well-being」（為了促進心理健康），選項 (A) To support psychological health 與之同義

REIMBURSE.example: The company will reimburse your costs.

examples.zh: 我無法保證它會起作用。

examples.zh: 公司保證全額退款。

examples.en: The TV comes with a two-year guarantee.
examples.zh: 這台電視附有兩年保固。

EXHIBITION.example: The exhibition has been visited by many people.
EXHIBITION.exampleZh: 許多人已經參觀過這個展覽。

examples.en: The exhibition has been visited by many people.
examples.zh: 許多人已經參觀過這個展覽。

examples.en: If you go to the exhibition, you will see some amazing art.
examples.zh: 如果你去這個展覽，你會看到一些驚人的藝術品。

TEMPORARY.example: This is only a temporary solution.
TEMPORARY.exampleZh: 這只是暫時的解決方法。

CREATING.example:
A: Why are they blocking the intersection?
B: They are discussing creating a pedestrian zone in this area.

TO KNOW.example:
Management Advice: When dealing with a DISPUTE, a good leader shouldn't pretend to know everything. Listening to both sides is always the best approach.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
TO KNOW.exampleZh: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法。

TO LOSE.example:
A: Why did you hire a personal trainer?
B: I was struggling to lose weight on my own.

AVOIDING.meaning: 本題在短文中考動名詞用法
AVOIDING.example:
Fitness Blog: I was lifting weights at the gym when I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder. My physical therapist suggested avoiding heavy objects for at least two weeks.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
AVOIDING.exampleZh: 本題在短文中考動名詞用法。

TO INVESTIGATE.example:
Banking Alert: Customers who notice any unusual charges on their statement should report them immediately. The bank claims to investigate all fraudulent activities within a week.
Q: Choose the correct grammar form.
TO INVESTIGATE.exampleZh: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法。

AGENDA.exampleZh: 我們來看看今天的議程。

POSTPONE.example: We postponed the meeting until Friday.
POSTPONE.exampleZh: 我們把會議延到星期五。

BROADCAST.example: The broadcast includes a recorded interview.

WARRANTY.example: This television comes with a two-year warranty, so you can get it fixed for free if it breaks.

REST.example: Get plenty of rest to recover quickly.

STAY.example: How long do you plan to stay in Taipei?
STAY.exampleZh: 您預計在台北停留多久？

TALK.example: I need to talk to you.

TAKE.example: It takes twenty minutes to walk there.
TAKE.exampleZh: 走路到那裡需要二十分鐘。

CAPTURE.example: The photo captures a beautiful moment.
CAPTURE.exampleZh: 這張照片捕捉到了一個美麗的瞬間。

KEY.example: Here is the front door key.

SOFTWARE.example: We need to update the software.

NEED.example: I need a pen to write.

ENGINEER.example: The software engineer solved the critical database issue yesterday.
ENGINEER.exampleZh: 那位軟體工程師昨天解決了嚴重的資料庫問題。

COMPUTER.example: I use a computer at work.

WAIT.example: Please wait in line for inspection.

CONSIDER.example: We are considering several different vendors.
CONSIDER.exampleZh: 我們正在考慮幾家不同的供應商。

BUS.example: I go to work by bus.

THERE.example: there are two birds in the park.
THERE.exampleZh: There are 表示「有」，後面接複數名詞 two birds，所以選 There。

CHEAP.example: This hotel is cheap and clean.

DELAYED.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「延遲；延誤」。

TWO.meaning: 數字 2 的英文是什麼？
TWO.example: The phrase "two" is frequently used in practical English communication.
TWO.exampleZh: 「two」是在實用英語溝通中經常運用的重要表達。

GET.example: He got a promotion last month.

BROKEN.example: He will fix the broken window tomorrow.
BROKEN.exampleZh: 他明天會修理破掉的窗戶。

RECEIPT.example: Excuse me, can I have the paper receipt to check the price of each item?
RECEIPT.exampleZh: 購物結帳後核對商品金額的明細紙條是「收據/發票」receipt。

BREAK.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
BREAK.example:

SUFFICIENT.example: If we had gathered sufficient evidence, we would have won the case.
SUFFICIENT.exampleZh: 如果我們收集了充足的證據，我們本可以贏得這個案子。

GOING.example: 「I am going to travel to Paris.」請選出正確符合未來式 going to 的選項：

BRANCH.example: The bank opened a new branch.

SEND.example: Please send the invoice to our finance department.

WALK.example: It is a five-minute walk from here.
WALK.exampleZh: 從這裡走過去只要五分鐘。

THURSDAY.example: We have a test on Thursday.

MOVE.example: The office will move to the fourth floor.

WRITE.example: She wrote a detailed summary of the event.
WRITE.exampleZh: 她寫了一份詳盡的活動摘要。

WORKING.example: We look forward to working with you.
WORKING.exampleZh: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

COMPANY.example: She works for a big company.

INTRODUCED.example: introduced as a temporary safeguard, the restriction gradually became permanent.
INTRODUCED.exampleZh: restriction 是被引入的限制，用過去分詞 Introduced。
